programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: It's a hair-raising episode as Eb (Tom Lester) enrolls in a correspondence course to become a barber. Lisa (Eva Gabor) and Oliver (Eddie Albert) give him the money to learn the trade but learning how to cut hair by mail has its glitches.

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: For a lawyer, Oliver should be more careful about what he signs. Lisa reminds him that two years ago Oliver made her a promise to take her back to New York for a two-week vacation. And she has it in writing on the bottom of the kitchen drawer.

programme.title: Green Acres

programme.title: Green Acres

programme.title: Green Acres
programme.desc: A charity rummage sale asks for donated clothing. Being among the wealthier residents of Hooterville, the organizers look to the Douglases. It isn't long before Oliver has to stop Lisa from giving away his entire wardrobe!

programme.desc: When Fire Chief Joe Carson is looking for a way to go to Miami, he hires Oliver as his assistant, hoping Oliver will pay for the trip. The plan backfires, no pun intended, when Oliver starts pointing out what a poor job the chief has been doing.

programme.desc: Lisa feels like she should be contributing more and wants to start working in Oliver's construction business. Lisa is like a fish out of water as she arrives to the Monroes' workshop in overalls and causes one problem after another.

programme.desc: When a charmingly sweet doe wanders onto the Douglas farm, an enchanted Lisa befriends the beautiful animal. Having had her heart won over, Lisa resolves to have all deer hunting banned in Hooterville, winning support however necessary.

programme.desc: Can jealousy be a good thing? Not for Rachel Rose, a physical therapist whose life is threatened when she come between her paraplegic patient and his amorous robotic companion who is programmed to remove any obstacle that stands in her way.

programme.desc: Two brothers wrestle for control of their father's million-dollar pharmaceutical company. But when one brother discovers a drug which may hold the secret to eternal life, the battle for control becomes a rapid trip toward self-destruction.

programme.desc: A dying race of aliens come to Earth to stop its own extinction...by reanimating human corpses. But a government doctor (Mykelti Williamson) senses that there may be more to their plans than mere survival! D. W. Moffett and Rae Dawn Chong also star.

programme.desc: Aggie (Thora Birch) is an outcast at her elementary school because strange things seem to happen around her. When she is suspended from school, her parents hire a nanny who seems to good to be true. Will they lose their only child to keep her safe?

programme.desc: When a college student (Josh Brolin) experimenting with time travel takes job with a prestigious lab, he doesn't realize that the lab's billionaire owner understands completely the financial and political benefits of seeing into the future.

programme.desc: Ben Kohler's (Sam Robards) life is saved after having an experimental microchip implanted in his brain, but when he starts seeing murders as if through the eyes of the killer, it becomes clear that something is desperately wrong.

programme.desc: When Father Anton, a priest who has been questioning his faith, stumbles and hits his head, he suddenly begins to see demons all about him. When those demons bestow upon him the power over life and death, he uses it...but nothing comes without a cost.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When Sharon Rosman's son is abducted his 6-year-old sister in the only witness but is far too traumatized to speak. When psychologist John Holland comes to work with the young girl, she tells him it was the boogeyman...from under the bed.

programme.desc: Dropped out of space by a chunk of dark matter, pilot Paul Stein (John Heard) discovers a derelict ship lost ten years ago with all hands, including his long-lost brother. Only it seems that the crew may not quite be dead...or alive.

programme.desc: Henry Marshall (Frank Whaley) is a greedy man. Recently released from prison, Marshall has learned little from his experiences. But an encounter with alien beings (Rebecca De Mornay and John Savage) may just teach him a thing or two.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: On a remote planet, Major Stokes (Robert Patrick), one of Earth's best warriors, has been captured by aliens and placed in a cell with a woman who is slowly being transformed into one of the aliens. Can he escape before he suffers a similar fate?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Hanna Velasic (Alyssa Milano) has a killer body...literally! When the formerly chaste beauty is taken over by a mysterious force, he appetite for men becomes insatiable...and murderous. Can her loving boyfriend put an end to her killing spree?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When a group of astronauts returning to Earth after an expedition to Mars discover what appears to be a dangerous alien life form on their ship, they must decide whether to return to Earth or sacrifice themselves for the sake of all humanity?

programme.desc: To cure his cancer, a man (Peter Outerbridge) secretly injects himself with experimental nanobots that his scientist friend (Richard Thomas) developed. The trial is successful -- too successful -- when the super 'bots try to create a superhuman!

programme.desc: When a robot named Adam is accused of killing his own creator, it's up to a civil liberties attorney (Leonard Nimoy) to defend him. Is Adam capable of murder? Or did a military retrofit of the docile robot turn him into a ruthless killing machine?

programme.desc: Lynda is a grieving mother who feels her son's spirit is haunting her. Levi is a scientist out to prove that ghosts do not exist. Can her faith and his skepticism come together to solve the mystery of a haunted house and a senseless death?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: An environmentally friendly U.S. Senator's life changes when, after a freak accident, he suddenly starts to believe he is an alien in disguise, with a "mission" to surreptitiously reconfigure the Earth's atmosphere. But is it for the better?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: After intercepting a strange phone call, a tenacious reporter (Ally Sheedy) finds herself in a deadly game of cat and mouse. The only clues to the mystery: a strange man with violet eyes and missing persons who leave behind a pile of purple ash.

programme.desc: When an accident puts Dr. Stein's (Mark Hamill) colleague, Rachel, in a coma, he uses his newly-created invention to reach her brain and tell her he loves her. However, Stein discovers that love takes strange turns when it enters the virtual world.

programme.desc: As he celebrates his first anniversary, Norman (Matt Frewer) thinks he's the luckiest man alive. But suddenly, his lovely wife doesn't seem the same and he can't stand to be around her. Is he going crazy or are his instincts telling him something?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: In a bizarre twist of fate, Nancy McDonald (Bonnie Bedelia) receives a distress call from Lindy (Chad Willett), a former lover, who was lost in space twenty years earlier. And he has a message: He's alive...and he desperately needs her help.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW

programme.desc: When a lonely physics professor Stanley Hurst (Michael Gross) realizes the sun is going to burn out, he knows that he and humanity have only a few hours to live. In that time, Stan resolves to make up for lost years.

programme.desc: When three young women age and die within hours, a small town is turned upside down. How does Helen (Maxine Miller), a doctor's aging mother, play into these deaths? The answer to the puzzling mystery of fragile youth is soon to be revealed.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's electrical output fails abruptly. Should they call a doctor or an electrician to bring Fester back? Morticia prescribes a bowl of porcupine mold, and both she an Gomez agree that long exposure to moon rays would be beneficial.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family would like to vacation on the moon, but the billion dollar travel cost is slightly prohibitive. Uncle Fester volunteers $21.13 and Morticia, using Gomez's new supercomputer, suggests placing a $2,000 bet on the daily double horse race.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Cousin Itt is advocated as curator of the local zoo. Gomez uses his influence with Park Commissioner Fisk (guest star Alan Reed) to promote Itt for the job, but the zookeepers are convinced the Addamses' cousin should be confined to a cage.
programme.sub-title: Cousin Itt Visits The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama (Blossom Rock) is hauled off to jail for setting up a fortune-telling booth in the Addamses' living room. Gomez (John Astin) volunteers to act as attorney, and the court session becomes a shambles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez (John Astin) loses his memory after hitting his head; he fails to recognize Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and says the house looks like a condemned museum. The Addamses take turns hitting Gomez on the head trying to help him regain his memory.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Thing disappears from his box. Failing to find a single trace of Thing, Gomez (John Astin) conducts an investigation--with all members of the household under suspicion. Also starring Carolyn Jones, Jackie Coogan, and Ted Cassidy.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester applies for a job as an insurance salesman with the same company which is threatening to cancel the Addamses' policy (because Fester keeps blowing things up). Fester convinces the company interviewer that he is qualified for the job.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes inconsolable when Gomez donates the family antique harpsichord to a collector. Gomez and Morticia offer Lurch a balalaika and a set of drums. When this proves unsatisfactory, Gomez and Fester decide to build a new harpsichord.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Morticia hears the stock market has crashed, she assumes that Gomez has been financially wiped out and rallies the family to help make money. Morticia gives lessons, Lurch and Fester run an escort service, and the kids run a poison drink stand.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While enjoying a moonlight picnic and snail hunt, the Addams Family is mistaken for Martians by uniformed investigators from Mysterious Space Objects Headquarters. In turn, Gomez (John Astin) and the clan regard their inquisitors with suspicion.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family And The Spaceman

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: An organ grinder's fugitive monkey leads Fester to believe that he has turned Pugsley into a monkey. Morticia and Gomez treat the monkey as though he were their son, welcoming him to the dinner table and giving him Pugsley's chores.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Moriticia's favorite charity is having an auction--so Morticia persuades her family to part with things to sell. Donations include Wednesday's headless doll, the old flogging table, a stuffed vulture and Uncle Fester's dynamite.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The Addams Family ignores notices that their house is to be condemned to make way for a freeway. When sudden explosions cannot be traced to any member of the family but, instead, to city workmen, Gomez is forced to consider moving the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's pen pal, Madelyn, is coming to visit. Fester panics, as he has described himself as handsome, heroic and romantic. Gomez and Morticia agree that all Fester needs is a toupee and they help him make several styles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez are worried about Cousin Itt because he spends his days sleeping and dreaming in his tiny room. They decide that Itt would make an excellent marriage counselor, and pretend to be a couple with a failing marriage.
programme.sub-title: Cousin Itt And The Vocational Counselor

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A recording company's platter of Lurch's gravelly voice brings a screaming mob of teenage fans to the Addams house. To calm the crowd, Lurch seats himself at the harpsichord and rewards his fans with a song to end all songs.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Taken in by a psychologist's pronouncement that the only happily married couples are those who fight, members of the Addams household devise schemes to start a battle between Gomez (John Astin) and Morticia (Carolyn Jones).

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez decides to bolster Cousin Itt's failing ego by making him the star of a production aimed as a birthday surprise for Wednesday. He hires the great director, Eric von Bissell, who gives Itt elocution lessons, causing a Hollywood star complex.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While Morticia and Gomez are celebrating their 13th wedding anniversary, she tells Wednesday and Pugsley a bedtime story of how she and Gomez first met. In this episode, Carolyn Jones plays Morticia, Morticia as a 22-year-old, and sister Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley refuse to go to bed until they hear the rest of the courtship story. Morticia resumes the tale via flashback, including the ceremony beginning with Ophelia Frump, Morticia's balmy sister, as the bride.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Romance seems close for Thing, the Addams right-hand-in-a-box, when Gomez's aunt arrives for a visit accompanied by Lady Fingers, her handmaiden. Thing enjoys the visit most because it gives him a chance to hold hands with one of his own kind.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez visit Mayor Henson to complain that their property tax is ridiculously low. After the Mayor proves his incompetence by offering a refund, Gomez is persuaded to become a candidate for the office.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: During a welcome home party for Cousin Itt, Morticia notices that the diminutive guest of honor seems to be losing his hair. Uncle Fester experiments with his chemistry set to produce a concoction that grows hair and tries the remedy on Itt.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley return in tears from trick-or-treating because a neighbor has told them there is no such thing as a witch. Morticia and Gomez plan to prove to the children that they do exist--by summoning a witch to a séance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Determined to correct the dreadful literature that Wednesday and Pugsley are exposed to, Morticia sets out to create a new literary world. Gomez fears that his wife's first manuscript is so good, that once the publisher reads it, he will lose her.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: In need of artistic fulfillment, Morticia takes up sculpting. An art critic views her first endeavor--a three-eyed Gomez statue--and clubs it with his cane. Gomez, who won't have Morticia's heart broken gets, a seedy art dealer to buy it.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley copies one of his dad's old love letters and sends it to his teacher. Miss Dunbar comes to visit the Addams home and confesses to Gomez that no man has ever fallen so in love with her, leading Morticia to pretend to be the jealous wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Wednesday befriends a new boy her age, Robespierre Courtney, Morticia invites his parents, Mr. and Mrs. Henry Courtney, to visit the Addams house for tea. Unbeknownst to them, the Courtney's are hoping to meet a number of the social set.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: There is a neighborhood burglar on the loose, and Morticia has reason to believe it could be Gomez. Morticia decides to probe his subconscious mind for a key to his criminality after she and Uncle Fester discover loot hidden in the storeroom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's pet plant Cleopatra gobbles up her favorite photo of Gomez from the family album. When the original photographer is found and asked to make a duplicate picture, it is discovered that he is now with the Department of Motor Vehicles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez plays host to Don Xavier Molines, a family friend during his childhood in Spain, and his daughter, Consuella. Morticia's hospitality is put to the test when Consuella reveals that she has been promised in marriage to Gomez since childhood.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Wednesday's and Pugsley's faith in Santa Claus is shaken, Uncle Fester is chosen to back up Santa in case the real St. Nick is too busy to come. However, Fester-Santa gets stuck in the chimney, so each of the other adults fill in for him.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Fester is so smitten upon receipt of a photo of his love, a bearded carnival lady, that he borrows stamp money to mail her a proposal. Morticia dons a beard and poses as the mother to convince Fester that he will have to work to support a wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Because she thinks Fester (Jackie Coogan) and Grandmama (Blossom Rock) are spoiling the children, Morticia (Carolyn Jones) hires a governess. Insulted, Fester paints a white line down the center of the Addams house, dividing it in half.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez see Fester conferring with TV muscleman Jack LaGrann (Jack LaLanne), and think that Fester is planning a television career. However, Uncle Fester confides to Lurch that he has to go on a secret diet and exercise.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez find Grandfather Pegleg's treasure map and summon Captain Grimby. They hope to charter his boat for the treasure hunt. But after meeting the Captain, Morticia is careful to keep the nature of the mission secret.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia Frump is madly in love with Horatio Bartholomew, the man who has everything, except the truth about her relatives. Morticia, not convinced by Bartholomew, persuades playboy Cousin Itt to stir the embers of his past romance with Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia, in order to be part of the National Beautification Program, decides to become a home decorator and offers her services to the neighbors. Next door neighbor, and insurance agent, Joe Digby hires Morticia in hopes of selling them insurance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia taunts Uncle Fester into announcing that he is going to join the Peace Corps. Fester feels he's a cinch to be accepted because Gomez plans to pull strings in Washington on his behalf. The entire family agrees to help him study for the exam.

programme.desc: Alma le advierte a Reverte que no permitirá que le diga la verdad a Roberta y viajará con ellos. José le pide a Luciano que trabaje en una empresa para que investigue un asunto. Iñaki se burla de Diego.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Miguel invita a Sabrina al Vacance Club; Pilar y Sol pretenden saber cuál es el peor secreto de Mía para divulgarlo; Diego le dice a Roberta que nunca pensó que se dejaría dominar; Lupita no sabe si regresar con Nico o andar con Santos.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Nico regresa de viaje, habla con Lupita para aclarar las cosas y le reclama por estar con otro. Los chicos se van de vacaciones para pasar Año Nuevo juntos.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Miguel invita a Sabrina a pasar fin de año con ellos en Valle. Roberta se encela de la hermana de Lupita, pues sale con Diego. Mía prepara la reunión de los secretos con Vico y Celina, Pilar graba la conversación. Alma se queda con Franco.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Sabrina le agradece a Miguel el tiempo que pasa con ella. Un ladrón roba la grabadora de Pilar, todos buscan al ladrón. Lola toma alcohol para demostrar que no es una niña. Roberta abofetea a Diego por emborrachar a Lola.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Miguel devuelve la grabadora perdida a Martín para entregársela a Gastón. Alma pasa año nuevo con Franco, Karla interrumpe su cena. Todos disfrutan de la fiesta de fin de año en el yate de Valle de Bravo, Nico celebra con su papá en la iglesia.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Miguel se escapa del colegio para acompañar a Sabrina a sus análisis, Teo le pide a su papá que los ayude para poder escaparse. Mía se entera de que Miguel está con la mamá de Teo y va a buscarlo al hospital. Roberta intenta detener a Mía.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Bianca le dice a Rocco que Lola y ella robaron unos exámenes; Roberta le dice a Mía que Miguel no se fue con Sabrina porque estaba con ella; Roberta insiste en que Sabrina le parece muy falsa; en la Casa Hogar, se sorprenden al ver entrar a Reverte.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Una mujer asalta la carnicería de Don Cosme y golpea a Diego. Teo encuentra a José en el hospital y se enfrenta a ella, pero es golpeado por Luciano. Roberta encuentra a Alma y Franco a punto de besarse. Miguel le confiesa a Mía que vio a Sabrina.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Roberta le pide a su mamá que no tenga ninguna relación con Franco porque es el papá de Mía y debido a que también son muy diferentes.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Lola golpea a Lupita. León manda a clausurar la carnicería de los papás de Giovanni. Mía le dice a Miguel que ya no se enojará de que Sabrina sea su amiga a cambio de que no le oculte nada.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Iñaki se queda sin Paloma y Roberta. León ordena a Diego que deje la banda como condición para reabrir la carnicería. Alma le dice a Franco que deben olvidar sus sentimientos. Sabrina busca a Miguel en el colegio y se encuentra con Mía.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Mia se depara com Miguel e Sabrina juntos e deixa os dois conversando. Sabrina considera a atitude estranha e Miguel responde que os dois têm uma relação de confiança.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Iñaki se niega a presentar a Roberta a sus padres como su novia. Diego confiesa que su padre le obligó a dejar la banda. Rocco descubre que Tato está vendiendo artículos robados. Roberta exige a Reverte que le cuente su historia.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Reverte miente a Roberta para que no descubra que es su padre. Lola intenta seducir a Diego, pero este la rechaza. Roberta se entera de que Iñaki ni siquiera tiene primos. Alma y Franco planean vivir con Roberta para que ella acepte a Franco.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Alma les dice a Roberta y a Mía que van a cenar todos juntos en casa de Franco. Raquel golpea a Sol por coquetear con Teo. Johnny firma con RBD para grabar su primer disco. Sabrina aprovecha la ausencia de Mía y lleva a Miguel a cenar.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Roberta se resiste a convivir con Franco y Mía. Santos habla con Lola para advertirle que Diego está enamorado de Roberta. Miguel es seducido por Sabrina y engaña a Mía. Diego le pide a Roberta que retomen su relación.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Miguel se siente terrible por haber dormido con Sabrina, después ella se presenta en la escuela. Llegan a hacer una auditoría a Gandía. Diego presenta a Lola como su novia. Mía le confiesa a Miguel que está lista para su primera vez con él.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Roberta va a casa de Reverte para descubrirlo. Miguel confiesa no haberse cuidado con Sabrina. Eligen a Mía y Roberta como capitanas del equipo de porristas. Mía le pide a Roberta consejos de sexualidad.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Roberta acompaña a Mía al ginecólogo porque necesita orientación sexual para planear su primera vez con Miguel.

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Raymundo y Viridiana le dicen a Lupita que Lola es adoptada. Franco le confiesa a Mía y Miguel que no sabe cómo hablar de sexo con ellos. Alma y Franco se besan y Reverte se molesta al verlos. Los chicos del otro Insti llegan y empieza la rivalidad.

programme.title: Una familia de diez
programme.desc: La familia López es notificada de que se les cortará el servicio del agua en su departamento. Los miembros de la familia intentan averiguar quién es el responsable de que les hayan retirado el servicio del agua.

programme.title: Una familia de diez
programme.desc: Plácido expresa ante su familia su sentir acerca de la falta de intimidad que existe en su hogar. La nueva dinámica para poder vivir en casa de los López es aportar dinero, de lo contrario deben tomar su turno para poder residir ahí.

programme.title: Una familia de diez
programme.desc: La familia López se reúne con Tecla para que confiese la verdad sobre su embarazo. Tecla admite que lo hizo porque le gustó y reitera que lo volvería hacer. Tecla confiesa que fue con Adolfo y que fueron tres veces.

programme.title: Una familia de diez
programme.desc: Esteban Arce contacta a Plácido para que concurse por una enorme casa libre de impuestos. Los López tendrán que contestar a cinco preguntas, sin embargo, como en la última se tardan, pierden el premio. Aun así, reciben una sorpresa.

programme.title: Una familia de diez
programme.desc: La familia López se queda sin hogar por un incendio. A causa de la desgracia, deben remodelar y volver a empezar. La policía arresta a Plácido por comprar muebles robados.

programme.title: Una familia de diez
programme.desc: Plácido regresa a su casa después de haber sido arrestado por la compra de muebles robados. Gaby y Plutarco logran conseguir muebles para la casa, también de dudosa procedencia.

programme.title: Una familia de diez
programme.desc: Plácido está preocupado a causa del desbalance económico que han sufrido por el incendio. Durante una reunión familiar, Plácido establece nuevas reglas y les exige a todos conseguir un trabajo.

programme.title: Una familia de diez
programme.desc: El administrador del edificio notifica a la familia López la venta del edificio donde viven, por lo que deben desalojar el departamento en menos de 24 horas, ya que un nuevo supermercado será construido ahí.

programme.title: Una familia de diez

programme.title: Una familia de diez

programme.title: Una familia de diez
programme.desc: Plácido se preocupa por una llamada de Don Justo y le expresa a su familia que tendrá una reunión con su jefe. Don Justo va a nombrar socio a quien le tenga su café caliente.

programme.title: Una familia de diez
programme.desc: Se va la luz en el apartamento de la familia López y comienzan a suceder cosas extrañas. Tecla es confundida con un fantasma. Don Arnoldo se da cuenta de que, mientras se fue la luz, han desaparecido sus tamales.

programme.title: Una familia de diez
programme.desc: Plácido y Plutarco se muestran muy contentos ante su familia y explican que Don Justo les ha dado sus primeras vacaciones pagadas. La familia López se organiza para salir juntos de paseo a Pepetongo.

programme.title: Una familia de diez
programme.desc: Don Arnoldo, mientras duerme, menciona que tiene un tesoro en el pueblo de Apaseo el Grande, Guanajuato. La familia López implementa un plan para la búsqueda del tesoro.

programme.title: Una familia de diez
programme.desc: Plácido es despedido de su trabajo a causa de un incidente de Plutarco con Don Justo. Licha, mientras lee una revista, encuentra un artículo de la bruja Madame Patú, experta en la lectura de cartas.

programme.title: Una familia de diez
programme.desc: Plácido busca trabajo desesperadamente. El único trabajo que logra encontrar Plácido es vendiendo tamales. Justito invita a su abuelo materno a cenar a su casa. Tecla abandona a la familia López.

programme.title: Una familia de diez
programme.desc: Licha fallece de manera inesperada y los López organizan un emotivo funeral, donde cumplen su última voluntad con sus cenizas. Llega alguien a la casa que amenaza con quedarse para siempre.

programme.title: Una familia de diez
programme.desc: Los López deben tres meses de alquiler y la Chivis los amenaza con el desalojo si no le entregan el dinero en 24 horas. Por otra parte, Carlos, el padre de la Nena, ha regresado con la intención de quedarse.

programme.title: Una familia de diez
programme.desc: Jacinta, mamá de Tecla, ha llegado con la intención de quedarse. Don Arnoldo no quiere que se quede, y Plácido le permitirá ser parte de la familia. Como le harán para que el administrador no encuentre el hoyo en la pared.

programme.title: Una familia de diez
programme.desc: Doña Romina escucha ruidos extraños en el departamento que ha invadido la familia López, en el que murió don Genaro el mes pasado. Por eso, doña Romina cree que un fantasma habita el lugar.

programme.title: Una familia de diez
programme.desc: Con todas las medicinas que dejó Licha, Justito y Victoria crean un compuesto químico que Plutarco se toma por accidente. La Nena finge estar enferma para quedarse con el cuarto de Gaby.

programme.title: Una familia de diez
programme.desc: Plácido no encuentra empleo, por lo que prefiere quedarse cómodamente en su sofá, al igual que hace su padre. Plácido exige a los miembros de la familia que atiendan todos sus deseos para no levantarse del sofá, y ellos ya no lo soportan más.

programme.title: Una familia de diez
programme.desc: Plácido tiene la posibilidad de recuperar su antiguo trabajo; pero don Justo le señala que ese puesto vacante solo es para Adolfo. Plutarco trabajará como sujeto de prueba de productos milagrosos.

programme.title: Una familia de diez
programme.desc: Plácido acaba de recordar que es su aniversario de bodas con Renata, por lo que le organizará una cena romántica. Martina invita al cine a la familia a ver el estreno de una película.

programme.title: Una familia de diez
programme.desc: Adolfo pierde el bono huachicolero por bañarse, y con la ayuda de Jacinta se convierte en hierbero. Carlos recibe regalos de un admirador secreto.

programme.desc: When a pro athlete is murdered, police embark on an international chase for the killer.
When a college student vanishes from a mall parking lot, police hunt her killer.
When a woman is killed in small-town Texas, a secret diary reveals the killer's motive.
programme.sub-title: There Is a Monster in Me

programme.desc: Three women -- one missing, one murdered, one kidnapped -- and the clues leading to a killer.
An inside look at an undercover investigation involving conspiracy, escorts and murder for hire.

John Quiñones reports on the story of a young husband, father and soldier murdered while at home for the holidays; interrogation tapes and extensive police body camera footage reveal a twisted tale of heartache and greed.
A Florida mom's mysterious death leads authorities to investigate the connection to a missing engagement ring, a disastrous home renovation, and a popular TV home-makeover show.
A Florida university campus is on edge when a student disappears; police say love, lies and obsession led to murder; a new witness comes forward with a claim that could potentially overturn the case.

More than a decade after a teenage girl vanishes from a popular tourist destination, her killer is brought to justice; interviews with the FBI team who broke the case wide open and identified her killer.
When four young women go missing, police hunt for a serial killer roaming the interstate; John Quiñones explores the families' quests for answers.

Ruby Franke is a popular YouTuber known for her strict parenting; after her emaciated son escapes, begging for help, her seemingly perfect world implodes; featuring all-new body camera footage, recorded calls and a look at Ruby's private journal.
programme.sub-title: Ruby Franke: From Momfluencer to Felon

programme.desc: When a young couple is found dead, police learn they were involved in an online feud and uncover a deadly catfishing scheme; "20/20" untangles the web of lies and unmasks the unlikely mastermind behind the murders.

When a 16-year-old girl disappears, police have a surveillance video showing her getting into an unknown vehicle shortly after midnight; when the truth of her disappearance finally comes to light, the community is shocked by who is behind the plot.
A beloved small-town minister is found killed in his family home and his wife and three children are nowhere to be found.
When a young mother goes missing, police question a pastor, the ex-husband and even a local ventriloquist.

When two teen girls never make it home after a night out, authorities discover their dead bodies in the trunk of a car; detectives go to exhaustive lengths to identify the killer, but it takes decades before they zero in on a very unlikely suspect.
When a beloved celebrity hairstylist is found murdered in his home, authorities consider whether it was a burglary gone wrong or something more sinister.
After the largest investigation in Tennessee's history, a key witness recants his testimony when the remains of a 20-year-old nursing student are found three years after her disappearance.

In the eyes of the law, a man killed his first wife, but his second wife thinks he is innocent; incredible new developments take this investigation in a completely new direction, as John Quiñones reports on the crime, the courts and the confession.
Interview with Keith Papini after his ex-wife, Sherri Papini, served 10 months in prison for lying to federal agents about her fabricated kidnapping.

programme.title: Champion
programme.desc: Dirt track racer Sean Weathers (Andrew Cheney) was at the top of his game with an unstoppable career. When a rivalry with another racer turns personal, the ego that propelled him to success causes a tragedy, sending his life into a tailspin. Jack Reed (Gary Graham) had prospered as a businessman but failed as a family man. In a sudden turn of events, his chances for reconciliation are ripped from his grasp. Sean and Jack's lives collide, and an unexpected bond forms between them.

programme.title: Learning to Love
programme.desc: Harry struggles to connect with his two daughters when they lose their faith after losing their mom. When they are faced with the prospect of a new nanny, they are pleasantly surprised by Steph, who floods their hearts with warmth and positivity.

programme.title: Indivisible
programme.desc: Fresh out of the seminary and basic training, Army chaplain Darren Turner receives orders to deploy to Iraq, leaving his wife behind to care for their three young children. The harsh realities of war soon take their toll on Turner and his battalion, making it hard to stay connected to his beloved family. When Darren finally comes home, the Turners must decide if they're willing to face one more battle -- the fight to save their marriage.

programme.title: Faith, Hope & Love
programme.desc: A recent divorcee enters into a dance contest in a desperate attempt to save her struggling dance studio.

programme.title: Not Your Romeo & Juliet
programme.desc: With a popular romance column and a perfect boyfriend, college student Micki seems to have figured out love. However, when another student launches an anti-romance column, it's love and war as Micki sets out to take down her rival at any cost.

programme.title: Summer Snow
programme.desc: Hallie, a small girl with a big heart, comes up with creative ways to help others, leaving her father Dan with a mess to clean up. When his wife dies, Dan struggles to keep it together while caring for his three children.

programme.desc: Rick Baldwin tries to manage a household and homeschool while reconnecting with his daughter Gracie.

When the car threatens a local school parade, the lives of the town's children and Wade's teacher girlfriend, Lauren, are endangered.

To accomplish their goal, the scientists (Antonio Moreno, Richard Carlson, Richard Denning, Whit Bissell) must brave the most perilous pieces of land South America has to offer. But the terrain is nothing compared to the danger posed by an otherworldly being that endangers their work and their lives.

When he leaves Don Alfredo to find work, Leon discovers that he has increasingly violent urges. Although these tendencies are calmed by Leon's love for the beautiful Christina (Catherine Feller), he ultimately cannot contain his curse and transforms into a werewolf, terrorizing the Spanish countryside.

Thorkel remains evasive about the nature of his experiments, and after the team evaluates his bacteria slides, he orders them away. When they refuse, Thorkel and his servant trick them into a chamber where Thorkel shrinks them down to microscopic size, and they escape to the terrifying jungle.

When he sets his sights on Mina (Helen Chandler), the daughter of a prominent doctor, vampire-hunter Van Helsing (Edward Van Sloan) is enlisted to put a stop to the count's never-ending bloodlust.

programme.title: The Great Debaters
programme.desc: Poet and professor Melvin B. Tolson teaches at the predominantly black Wiley College in 1935 Texas. He decides to start a debate team, something nearly unheard of at a black college. While at first he butts heads with the influential father of one of his best debaters, eventually he is able to form a team of strong-minded, intelligent young students, and they become the first black debate team to challenge Harvard's prestigious debate champions.

programme.title: Pride
programme.desc: In the 1970s Philadelphia, Jim Ellis, who is driven by a love of competitive swimming, fixes up an abandoned pool building with the help of a janitor named Elston. But when city officials mark the place for demolition, he fights back by founding an all-black swim team. Facing racism, violence and a hostile city official, Jim struggles to prepare his novice swimmers for the state championships.

programme.title: Fruitvale Station
programme.desc: Though he once spent time in San Quentin, 22-year-old black man Oscar Grant (Michael B. Jordan) is now trying hard to live a clean life and support his girlfriend (Melonie Diaz) and young daughter (Ariana Neal). Flashbacks reveal the last day in Oscar's life, in which he accompanied his family and friends to San Francisco to watch fireworks on New Year's Eve, and, on the way back home, became swept up in an altercation with police that ended in tragedy. Based on a true story.

programme.title: Tyler Perry's Good Deeds
programme.desc: For all his life, wealthy businessman Wesley Deeds (Tyler Perry) has done what's expected of him and has settled into a predictable routine. His life begins to change, however, when he meets Lindsey Wakefield (Thandie Newton), a struggling single mother who has just been evicted. Wesley offers to help Lindsey get back on her feet and, though he's already engaged, romantic sparks begin to fly. Suddenly, Wesley finds himself torn between what is expected of him and what he really wants.

programme.title: It Follows
programme.desc: After carefree teenager Jay (Maika Monroe) sleeps with her new boyfriend, Hugh (Jake Weary), for the first time, she learns that she is the latest recipient of a fatal curse that is passed from victim to victim via sexual intercourse. Death, Jay learns, will creep inexorably toward her as either a friend or a stranger. Jay's friends don't believe her seemingly paranoid ravings, until they too begin to see the phantom assassins and band together to help her flee or defend herself.

programme.title: Warm Bodies
programme.desc: A terrible plague has left the planet's population divided between zombies and humans. An unusual zombie named R (Nicholas Hoult) sees his walking-dead brethren attacking a living woman named Julie (Teresa Palmer) and rescues her. Julie sees that R is different from the other zombies, and the pair embark on an unusual relationship. As their bond grows and R becomes more and more human, a chain of events unfolds that could transform the entire lifeless world.

programme.title: All the Boys Love Mandy Lane

After hitching a ride with a vaguely scary older man (Anson Mount), the teens arrive at their destination. Partying ensues, and Mandy's close pal, Emmet (Michael Welch), keeps a watchful eye on the young males making a play for Mandy. Then two of the students are murdered.

programme.title: My Bloody Valentine
programme.desc: Ten years ago, an inexperienced coal miner named Tom Hanniger caused an accident that killed five men and put a sixth, Harry Warden, into a coma. A year later, on Valentine's Day, Harry woke up and murdered 22 people with a pickaxe before dying. Now Tom has returned home, still haunted by the past. And something else is back in Harmony: a pickaxe-wielding killer in a miner's mask, who may be the ghost of Harry, come to claim Tom and his friends.

One player tries to guess a word based on clues offered by his or her partner. The game is timed, and if the clue-giver inadvertently says part of the word, a buzzer sounds and that round is lost. The team with the most points at the end of the round gets to go on to a fast-paced bonus round called Cashword.

programme.title: Malverde, la leyenda
programme.desc: En el norte de México, un famoso bandolero se gana a la gente al repartir parte del producto de sus robos entre la población.

programme.title: El Hechizo del Pantano
programme.desc: Un niño juega en el bosque con una chiquilla y cuando su padre se entera descubren que ella murió años atrás.

programme.title: El tesoro del amazonas
programme.desc: Un aventurero y sus amigos compiten contra un ex-nazi y otras personas que buscan un tesoro de diamantes en la selva sudamericana.

programme.title: La historia de un gángster
programme.desc: La historia de un delincuente que sale de prisión antes de tiempo por buena conducta, pero este vuelve a meterse en problemas y retoma la vida criminal.

programme.title: La piel de la muerte
programme.desc: Dos mujeres huérfanas protegen un tesoro escondido al que todo el mundo anda buscando en el desierto.

programme.title: Los desalmados
programme.desc: Dos cazarrecompensas se convierten en fieles y buenos amigos, a pesar de los problemas debido a sus profesiones.

programme.title: El Hijo del Otro
programme.desc: Una mujer le habla de su embarazo a su esposo, un hombre estéril. Más tarde él descubre que fue inseminación artificial.

programme.title: Pistoleros bajo el sol
programme.desc: En un pueblo azotado por un ciclón, matan a un investigador. Su hermano, Tony, llega para hacer su trabajo y también lo atacan. Martha arriesga su vida para ubicar a los criminales.

programme.title: El Color de Nuestra Piel
programme.desc: Una familia tiene un hijo rubio al que consiente y otro moreno que se siente desplazado aunque es bueno y trabajador.

programme.title: El guerrillero de Chiapas
programme.desc: Dramatización del levantamiento, liderado por el Subcomandante Marcos, ocurrido en el estado de Chiapas en la década de 1990.

programme.title: Albures Mexicanos
programme.desc: Un grupo de bailarinas y cómicos se quedan sin teatro para sus presentaciones y se establecen en un terreno ajeno.

programme.title: Piernas cruzadas
programme.desc: Una cantante de flamenco español y una chica tímida cambian de identidades, pues son físicamente muy parecidas.

programme.title: Sor Batalla
programme.desc: Una monja es enviada a un pueblo lejano, gobernado por un hombre malvado, y con su fe y alegría intenta cambiarlo.

programme.title: Operación 67
programme.desc: Una banda oriental intenta falsificar las placas con que se imprimen los billetes de un país latino para desestabilizarlo.

programme.title: Los supersabios
programme.desc: Los supersabios construyen un cohete espacial. Panza Y Pola provocan la curiosidad de los villanos Solomillo y el médico. Los muchachos despegan su nave y se encuentran con Panza y Pola para comenzar a explorar.

programme.title: El tesoro de Moctezuma
programme.desc: Santo y dos agentes enfrentan a unos villanos cuando se tratan de robar el tesoro de Moctezuma.

programme.title: Visita al Pasado
programme.desc: Un grupo de niños que viaja a través del tiempo al siglo XVII hacen frente a un castillo embrujado.

programme.title: Santo contra el doctor Muerte
programme.desc: Santo investiga la desaparición de obras de arte originales que fueron suplantadas por copias baratas.

programme.title: Silencio asesino
programme.desc: Una joven rica es secuestrada por unos delincuentes, pero uno de sus captores se convierte en su protector.
